creativeDirection: A restrained, premium Korean product commercial about Pli, a voice companion for family drives on Pleos. The user's flow (restless child and strained mother in an older car -> the same family in a new Pleos car where Pli greets the child, they play, and the mother simply drives) is narrative intent only. Planning labels and joke annotations are never rendered as titles. Every shot is generated moving footage; no slideshow, frozen keyframe, Ken Burns move or storyboard panel.
continuity: Same fictional Korean mother in her early thirties with a short dark bob, ivory knit cardigan and pale-blue shirt; same five-year-old daughter Hayeon with straight bangs, mustard hair clip and peach sweatshirt, always harnessed in a rear child seat. Left-hand-drive cars. The driver keeps her eyes on the road and both hands on the wheel. Pli is a soft yellow star on the forest-green Pleos display. Generated footage is an AI commercial, never evidence of app or vehicle behaviour.

shots.prompt: Cinematic live-action car commercial, inside an older compact sedan driving slowly through a gray city morning. In the rear child seat the little girl in a peach sweatshirt squirms restlessly, kicks her legs, throws her head back and whines toward her mother, waving one hand impatiently. The mother keeps both hands on the steering wheel and her eyes on the road, exhales a tired sigh, her shoulders tense, she makes small steering corrections. Apartment buildings and the riverside road glide past the windows with natural parallax. Gentle handheld camera sway, natural lighting, realistic skin and fabric motion.

Cinematic live-action car commercial. Close shot of a Korean mother in her thirties with a short dark bob and an ivory knit cardigan, driving an older compact sedan on an overcast city morning. Both hands stay on the steering wheel and her eyes stay on the road ahead. Her daughter keeps whining from the back seat off screen; the mother's brow tightens, she presses her lips together, lets out a long tired sigh and blinks slowly, then refocuses on the road with visible strain, making small steering corrections. Gray apartment blocks and lamp posts slide past the side window with natural parallax. Slight handheld camera sway, soft overcast light, realistic skin and hair motion.

Premium automotive commercial. A midnight-green luxury sedan with a thin continuous horizontal front light bar glides forward along a quiet tree-lined boulevard in warm morning sunlight. Its wheels rotate, the asphalt and lane markings flow beneath it, cherry blossom petals drift through the air, and sunlight and tree reflections slide across the polished body. The camera tracks backward smoothly at a low angle, keeping the car centered in its lane. Calm, elegant, realistic motion, shallow depth of field.

Feature scenes: real recordings of the public Pli APK on the Pleos emulator (full display 2560x1440, night mode), answering those voices on a weekday 17:30 drive home in Gwanggyo; Pli speaks with its own voice (answers the car speaks again and again served from the edge voice cache: renditions by a commercial voice, MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD (Exuberant_Girl, happy, 1.15x) via Figma Weave, each checked by Whisper; new answers live from Supertonic 3 F3 at 1.4x. APK with the driving render budget: no title, entry or typing motion while the car drives, so the Pleos driving view keeps 28-30 redraws/s while Pli speaks).
